name: Tundra Apparel & Promotions
old_description: Providing quality in quantity to Northeastern Wisconsin and beyond.
about:
Tundra Apparel & Promotions was founded in 2006 in Green Bay, Wisconsin. The company operates from a facility on Ashwaubenon Street and serves customers across Northeastern Wisconsin and beyond.

The shop provides custom decoration services including screen printing, embroidery, applique, heat press, and general customization. An in-house design team prepares artwork for production, and all work is performed on-site by a print crew with more than 20 years of combined experience. The company handles order quantities ranging from single pieces to runs of 1,000 or more, with a standard turnaround of 7 to 10 business days and quotes delivered within 24 hours.

Clients include event organizers such as Gus Macker, corporate accounts like Red Hat, and design firms such as White Design House. The business focuses on decorated apparel and promotional products for a variety of promotional and branding needs.

Tundra emphasizes that every item moves through the full production process in its own facility, eliminating middleman markups. Each piece is inspected before delivery, and the company positions its pricing as competitive because it controls the entire workflow from design to finished goods.
